description: Counts the rainbow chart's past, day by day, from the full price record since 2010: the highest band the price ever reached and the first date it reached it, the furthest the price ever sat above or below the trend line (in percent, with the date), how many of all priced days the price spent in each of the nine bands and outside the ladder (with the first and most recent dates in each and the longest unbroken run there), how long since the last close in the top and bottom bands, and today's counted position against that history (the share of all priced days that sat at or below where the price sits today against the line). Call it when the user asks about the chart's past: 'ever', 'has it ever', 'when was the last time', 'how long did it spend', the highest band ever. Counts of past days only: not odds, not a forecast, not advice.
name: rainbow_history
title: Bitcoin rainbow history
